evidence: Homepage shows 6 templates each with author (e.g. Sarah Chen), description text, category/scenario tags.
Each card shows title, author, description, category tag, scenario tag, usage count (e.g. "1,250 uses"), and update date (e.g. "Updated 2024-12-01").
Clicking Use Template opened a dialog showing template details (title, category, scenario, author, uses) and a Fill Template form with all fields.
Dialog shows 'Required fields missing' banner listing all missing required field names, and Preview Result tab is disabled.
Preview Result tab is disabled while required fields are empty.

All 14 fields (Full Name, Job Title, Email, Phone, Professional Summary, Company Name, Position, Start Date, End Date, Responsibilities, Degree, School, Graduation Year, Skills) accepted typed values.
Preview Result tab rendered with all entered values substituted (John Smith, Software Engineer, Tech Corp, etc.) into the resume template layout.

Preview shows heading level1 name, heading2 sections (Professional Summary, Experience, Education, Skills), heading3 job title, separator line, emphasis (Jan 2020 - Present), and strong/bold text (degree) - all Markdown constructs rendered correctly with placeholders substituted.

issue: Email field does not validate format
actual: Entered 'invalidemail' (no @ or domain) into the required Email field; the Preview tab became enabled and the preview rendered the invalid string literally ('| invalidemail |') instead of rejecting the value or keeping the preview unavailable.

evidence: Clicking Copy to Clipboard triggered a toast: 'Copied to clipboard! The generated content has been copied.'

issue: Markdown-altering special characters not fully neutralized
actual: Entering '# Test Heading **Bold Text**' in the Full Name field: the app blocked characters < > { } [ ] \\ | ` with an error, but allowed '**' through unescaped. In the generated preview, '**Bold Text**' was actually rendered as bold (strong) text inside the H1 heading, meaning user-supplied Markdown syntax altered the generated formatting/structure instead of being neutralized or escaped.

evidence: Clicking the favorite icon on Professional Resume immediately marked the button active and updated header Favorites badge from no count to '1'.
Favorited 2 templates (Professional Resume, Weekly Status Report); clicking header Favorites button opened a favorites-only view showing 'Showing 2 of 6 templates' with only those two cards.
While in favorites-only view (2 favorited), typing 'Resume' in search narrowed results to 'Showing 1 of 6 templates' displaying only Professional Resume.

Typing 'Resume' (>=2 chars) showed a real-time suggestion dropdown with 'Professional Resume'; clicking it filled the search box with 'Professional Resume' and narrowed results to 1 of 6 matching templates.

Category filter (Resume) narrowed to 1/6; Scenario filter (Academic) narrowed to 1/6; Sort By Alphabetical reordered cards to Academic, Meeting Minutes, Professional Email, Professional Resume, Project Proposal, Weekly Status Report - correct alphabetical order.
All filter/sort/search/favorites changes updated the visible card list and 'Showing X of 6' count instantly without any page navigation or reload.

actual: Searching 'Resme' (missing letter from 'Resume') and 'Meetign' (transposed letters from 'Meeting') both returned 'Showing 0 of 6 templates' / 'No templates found', with no suggestions and no matching templates returned, instead of tolerating the small typo.

evidence: Submitting with all fields blank showed 'Missing required fields' toast; after filling title/author/description/content but no field defined, submit was blocked with 'No fields defined' toast requiring at least one field.

issue: Field/placeholder mapping not validated on submit
actual: Submitted a template with a declared field 'Age' ({{age}}) that has no matching placeholder in the content, and content containing {{name}} twice with no declared 'name' field. Submission succeeded ('Template submitted!'). Opening the template and viewing Preview Result showed the literal unresolved placeholders '{{name}}' in the heading and body instead of being rejected at submission or substituted.

evidence: Submitted template appeared in library ('Showing 7 of 7'), was selectable via Use Template, and opened its Fill/Preview dialog.

issue: Duplicate field labels are silently accepted and collide into a single value
actual: Submitted a custom template with two fields both labeled 'Name' (one required, one optional), both mapping to the same {{name}} placeholder, with no warning or rejection at submission. In the Fill Template form, both fields render as separate inputs, but they share the same underlying state: typing 'Alice' into the first Name field and then 'Bob' into the second Name field silently overwrote the first value system-wide - both input boxes displayed 'Bob' afterward. The Preview Result confirmed only 'Bob' was used everywhere ('Memo from Bob', 'Bob says: Team Update'), with 'Alice' silently discarded with no error or disambiguation.

evidence: Submitted custom 'Quick Memo' template (title, author, description, Markdown content with {{name}}/{{subject}} placeholders, 3 fields). Submission succeeded with toast 'Template submitted!' and library count updated from 7 to 8 instantly. Filling the form and viewing Preview Result correctly substituted field values into the template ('Memo from Bob', 'Subject: Team Update', 'Bob says: Team Update'), confirming custom template creation and usage works end-to-end for valid field/placeholder mappings.

Custom submitted template ('Quick Memo') correctly displayed its author 'QA Tester', description, category 'Other', scenario 'Business', '0 uses', and 'Updated 2026-08-24' on its library card, matching the metadata entered during submission.

Markdown template content renders correctly as formatted output: Professional Resume preview showed proper heading levels (H1 name, H2 sections, H3 job title), bold/strong and emphasis/italic text, and separators. Quick Memo preview also correctly rendered '# Memo from {{name}}' as an H1 heading and '**Subject:**' as bold text, with plain paragraph text below - confirming consistent, correct Markdown-to-HTML rendering across templates.

After navigating/reloading http://localhost:6089/, 'Showing 8 of 8 templates' persisted (both custom-submitted templates 'Quick Memo' and 'Test Template No Fields' still present in the library), and the Favorites badge still showed '3', confirming favorites and custom template submissions persist across a page reload.
